cat /tmp/frontier_pptx/ppt/slides/slide11.xml | python3 -c "
import sys, re
content = sys.stdin.read()
# Extract all text boxes in order
shapes = re.findall(r'<p:sp>.*?</p:sp>', content, re.DOTALL)
for i, sp in enumerate(shapes):
    texts = re.findall(r'<a:t>([^<]*)</a:t>', sp)
    text_clean = ' | '.join(t for t in texts if t.strip())
    if text_clean:
        print(f'Shape {i}: {text_clean[:100]}')
"
